# Third-party provenance

TRM reference: https://github.com/SamsungSAILMontreal/TinyRecursiveModels
Pinned commit: c01103738605ba39d1430519b1ee0c62f4c707f8.
License: MIT, reproduced in TRM_LICENSE.txt.

The official source is checked out separately by experiments/arc/upstream.py;
its tracked files are not rewritten. The augmentation ID convention, ARC canvas
codec, ranking semantics, and ACT adapter follow that reference. The new
numerical solvers and answer-conditioned operator are implemented in this repo.
